schemaVersion.description: Spec version stamped at write time; never rewritten.

packageId.description: Equals the run-slug (spec section 1). Pattern enforces the section 1 grammar. Stable, sortable, non-secret.

taskKey.description: Cross-attempt family key (spec section 1). Normalized ticket when present (e.g. proj-1), else a hash of the normalized task (title+description+AC). Derived, never coordinator-assigned; keys indexes/by-task/. Non-secret. Shape is normative: the normalized-ticket form (lowercase alnum runs joined by single hyphens, exactly what derivation emits) or task-<16hex> for ticketless work. Ticket-correspondence (taskKey equals the normalized manifest.task.ticket when present) is a cross-field rule the reference validator enforces - JSON Schema cannot express it.

surface.description: Producer surface. Open vocabulary; consumers preserve unknown values. Safe-segment shape (writer additionally enforces path containment): no separators, no '..', no leading dot.

project.description: Project/repo key, e.g. my-project-farm. Safe-segment shape (writer additionally enforces path containment): no separators, no '..', no leading dot.

repo.description: Optional VCS repo slug the work targeted.

domain.description: Domain/team tier key. Empty string if none. Safe-segment shape or empty (writer additionally enforces path containment): no separators, no '..', no leading dot.

flow.description: e.g. dev, fix-bug, review. Safe-segment shape (writer additionally enforces path containment): no separators, no '..', no leading dot.

runner.description: The evidence producer. Any producer stamps its own runner; no default is a package constant.

model.description: Agent model id that executed the run.

harnessSchemaVersion.description: schemaVersion from the runner --json envelope when present. Absent for skill-only runs.

ticket.description: Work identifier, e.g. PROJ-1. Not PII.

sourceRef.description: Non-secret pointer (URL or path key) to the origin.

files.description: Package-file to integrity record. Enables consumers to verify package integrity without farmslot. Keys are package-relative paths.

status.description: MUST be 'pass' for any written package. 'blocked' packages are never written to a shared destination.

floorVersion.description: Version of the crypto-secret floor deny-set applied.

extensions.description: Open object. Farm/personal/tool-specific fields ONLY here. Never add keys to the closed core without a schemaVersion bump.
